description: BUG-13: the lookbehind blocks a match at `dist-share/...` because a `/` precedes it, but `-` was not in the class, so the pattern restarted inside the segment and reported `share/index.html` - a suffix of a path fragment. Same defect as BUG-08 with a different character; the rule missed there is that no match may begin at a character the segment class would have consumed. A hyphenated path in ordinary use is still reported whole.
